scope: UC24 Ticket Orders and UC25 unpaid ticket order cancellation MVP

database.name: travelio_db
database.storage: Booking.vendor_id links vendor; BookingDetail keeps service/type/quantity/price snapshots; Booking.cancellation_requests embeds reason/status/customer/vendor/timestamps and history.

features: Public attraction API excludes inactive ticket types and services without sellable types
Customer ticket selection displays unit prices, line totals, total quantity and total price; refresh and window focus fetch current vendor data
Backend recomputes prices and creates only PENDING unpaid orders; request UUID prevents duplicates
Vendor Ticket Orders list/detail with search and order/cancellation filters, restricted to owned services
Customer order detail with cancellation reasons and processing history
Vendor accepts or rejects cancellation; rejection allows customer to resubmit
Approval atomically changes order to CANCELLED and restores reserved inventory once
No Payment, refund, wallet, settlement or issued QR records created; Attraction QR/settlement routes and navigation deferred
Hotel Owner QR access retained; customer/vendor permissions checked against current account state

unitTests.skipReason: Optional isolated MongoDB suite not run; live checks use current MongoDB instead

validation.browserVendorCreationAndPurchase: Passed real registration, ticket CRUD, public selection, 380000 unpaid booking and vendor access using localhost:5173 and localhost:5000
validation.browserCancellation: Desktop 1280px and mobile 390px, customer history/reason validation, vendor search/filter/detail, reject/resubmit/approve, retained history, QR redirect; evidence in ticket-orders-browser-results.json
validation.focusedFrontendLint: Passed without warnings on new components/pages and affected API/navigation components
existingWarnings: Existing unused imports/state and Date render warnings in HotelOwnerDashboardPage.jsx

limits: Vendor lists return at most 100 newest orders matching search/filters
Each new order contains services from one vendor; historical mixed-vendor orders expose only owned lines and cannot be cancelled through this MVP
Only unpaid Pending attraction orders without issued QR or redeemed points can request cancellation
Integration/browser checks create clearly named test accounts/services/orders in current database through normal APIs and retain them as evidence
